audit: P1 Target Normalization — Semantic Preservation & Scale Matching

1_executive_summary.headline: For P1 goal 'preserve facet meaning/sign/zero/magnitude while enabling U+MFE and MAE+Giveback+Chop summation', scale-only Std (X/sigma_prefix) is most semantically aligned among tested options. It preserves sign and zero, maintains 2x magnitude ratios, and improves facet balance vs Raw. Standard Z-score improves scale balance but re-centers labels so raw favorable U>0 can become z(U)<0 (~63.2% flip on eval). Raw preserves semantics but fails scale balance. RMS-scale is near-Std-scale; choose between them after regime sensitivity check. No canonical adoption in this step.
